subject: Draft BL TOSHK2404187 for checking - Sunny Export / Qingdao-Singapore
body:
Dear Sirs,

Please find attached our handwritten Shipping Instruction dated 12 April 2024 and the draft Bill of Lading TOSHK2404187 received from Trans Ocean Shipping.

Kindly check both documents against each other and revert with any discrepancy before we confirm issuance.

Best regards,
Li Wei
Sunny Export Co., Ltd.
Qingdao, China
note: Email body is SYNTHETIC -- the source image contains only the SI and the BL. Scan variant: the attachments are image-only PDFs of the SI and BL crops, so extraction takes the VLM fallback path.
